propositions: Operators performing SSM deploys lack the prod instance id and AWS region in the review-bot-ops runbook, forcing them to guess or consult external sources like ADR-0026 and terraform files.
The runbook must document the prod instance (i-00880b2c7f13527c5), region (us-east-1), account (896586841071), and SSM connect command snippets in a single reference section.

The autodeploy.sh behavior regarding self-update must be accurately documented: the script body auto-updates via BOT_PATHS rsync, but script-only commits trigger no deploy and require hand-deployment; only installer and systemd unit files are excluded from re-materialization.
Region configuration is single-sourced in terraform (var.aws_region default + versions.tf backend) and the runbook must cite these as the authoritative source.
The change is documentation-only with no behavior modifications to the infrastructure or deployment process.
